scope: FIRST independent offline DISPLAY-only pixel review of the four NEW t15 choice-only captures

overall.reason: Two localized line-leading punctuation defects fall short of professional typography. All four views otherwise have complete readable question/option coverage and a complete, unclipped figure 43.

existingAssertionsReusedNotRerun: no answer-key exposure, overflow or errors

method.questionLocationConvention: Q1 through Q11 are top-to-bottom choice-question ordinals in each screenshot; option ordinals are top-to-bottom within the question.
method.coverage: Each full-page image was inspected from the heading through Q11 option 4 and the bottom margin. Every stem and every option row was visually covered, not just sampled.

coverageInventoryForEachView.pixelChecks: Stem, charge/capacitance inline symbols, signed power superscripts, multiplication marks, units and all four radio rows.
Long stem, Greek symbols, zero subscript, signed exponent, period-pair subscripts, tuple parentheses, commas, micro-unit glyphs and all four radio rows.
Wrapped stem and all four arrow-separated option pairs, including the right-hand values and units.
Stem, area superscript, inline units, decimal option text and all four radio rows.
Entire long stem and all five checkbox statements; vector accents, calligraphic glyphs, amplitude subscript, derivative notation, absolute-value bars, signs and wrapped continuation lines.
Stem, frequency/voltage/current symbols, current-amplitude subscript and all four radio rows.
Stem, micro-unit glyph, all four numeric option labels, omega-shaped unit glyphs and radio rows.
Stem, amplitude subscripts, degree marks on every applicable option and all four radio rows.
Entire stem, current tuple with DC/AC/rms subscripts, parentheses, commas, mixed unit lengths and all four radio rows.
Entire stem, exponential superscript, phasor underlines/subscripts, full figure 43, every one of the six checkbox statements and their wrapped continuation lines.
Entire final stem, numbered subscripts, signed power superscript, all four micro-unit radio options and whitespace below the bottommost row.

location.anchor: The question mark immediately after the parenthesized period pair; before the epsilon-zero constant instruction.

findings.observation: The closing parenthesis remains at the end of stem line 3, but the associated question mark begins line 4 at the left text edge. The punctuation is visible, not missing or clipped, but is visually detached from the question it terminates.
findings.requestedRevision: Keep that closing question punctuation with its preceding parenthesized expression without reducing text size.

location.anchor: The separator immediately after the final frequency/unit expression in the sentence beginning 'Each option lists'; before 'these endpoints define'.

findings.observation: The frequency/unit expression ends stem line 5 while its separator starts stem line 6 at the left text edge. The following wording is readable, but the line-leading separator is an avoidable punctuation orphan.
findings.requestedRevision: Keep the separator with the preceding frequency/unit expression, preserving readable mobile type and the existing content.

observations.typography: Black Chinese prose and mathematical serif glyphs are crisp against white. The heading and thin question separators establish a consistent hierarchy. DISPLAY-001 identifies the isolated Q2 punctuation defect.
observations.rowsAndControls: All nine radio groups and both checkbox groups are visually present. Filled blue and empty controls remain distinct; controls align with the first option line and never overlap labels.
observations.wrapping: Q5 options 4 and 5 wrap beneath their text column, not beneath their checkboxes. The full long Q10 stem fits the centered column. No stem or option collides with the next question.
observations.mathDisplay: Superscripts, tuple subscripts, Greek letters, vector accents, arrows, degree marks, absolute-value bars and Q10 phasor marks remain visible throughout Q1-Q11. No visible raw TeX, error-colored formula or replacement-glyph box was found. This is glyph/layout inspection only.
observations.figure43: In Q10, both capacitor strokes, resistor outline, C/R/L labels, both right terminal rings, the complete right-hand voltage label including its final character, and every bottom coil lobe are present. Figure ink has clearance from the stem and first option. No rightmost or bottommost element is clipped.
observations.bottommostContent: Q11 option 4 and its radio circle are entirely visible, with white margin below. The capture does not end inside a row.

limitations: No native-pixel zoom or reopen was used. Exact CSS font size, minimum-16-pixel conformance and antialiasing metrics were not independently measured.
Static pixels establish visible control states, not behavior; the already-passed interaction assertions were reused without rerunning.

observations.typography: The Practice heading, serif prose, mathematical glyphs and thin separators form a consistent restrained layout. The longer English stems have comfortable line spacing and remain readable across the entire capture.
observations.rowsAndControls: Every radio and checkbox row is fully present, with a consistent left control column and clear blue selected states. Q5 and Q10 checkbox labels do not cover their controls.
observations.wrapping: The Q2 constant breaks onto the following line with its digits and units visible. Q5 options 1, 3, 4 and 5 use hanging continuation lines with adequate row height. Q9's subscripted tuple remains complete on its last stem line; Q10's long stem and all six options fit.
observations.mathDisplay: Q1 scientific-notation superscripts, Q2 Greek/subscripted symbols and micro-unit tuples, Q3 arrows, Q4 area superscript, Q5 vector/calligraphic/sign glyphs, Q6 current subscript, Q7 unit symbols, Q8 degrees, Q9 compound subscripts, Q10 exponential and phasor marks, and Q11 numbered subscripts are visually intact. No visible raw TeX, formula error or missing-glyph box was found.
observations.figure43: Q10's entire circuit is visible at the centered desktop size. C/R/L labels, capacitor strokes, resistor edges, both right terminal rings, the rightmost voltage-label ending and all bottom coil curves are clear and unclipped. No prose or control overlaps figure ink.
observations.bottommostContent: All four Q11 option rows, including the final radio circle and unit glyph, precede a visible bottom white margin.

limitations: The full-page presentation supports reading stems/options and inspecting figure boundaries, but does not provide an independent measurement of CSS font sizes or native-pixel antialiasing.
Selection behavior was not inferred from the screenshot; existing behavior evidence was reused.

Q5's five statements wrap cleanly. Q10 options 2 and 3 have short final lines, but the words and punctuation remain legible and separate from the next row. Q11's wrapped stem and all options remain complete.

observations.figure43: The Q10 figure fits between the mobile gutters. Its top capacitor strokes, resistor outline, C/R/L labels, both right rings, complete voltage label to the right, and complete bottom coil remain visible. Bottom curves have white clearance above the first checkbox row. No rightmost or bottommost figure element is cut off.

observations.typography: All English stems and option labels are readable despite the tool's automatic full-page downscale. The heading, separators and text column remain coherent. DISPLAY-002 identifies the isolated Q3 punctuation orphan.
observations.rowsAndControls: Every one of the 47 rows is visible. Selected/empty controls remain distinguishable. Multi-line Q5 statements and all six Q10 statements stay aligned to their text column and do not overlap their checkboxes.
observations.wrapping: Q2's long stem, period tuple and constant stay inside the gutters. Q3's option arrows and right-hand units fit; its stem separator needs the local typography revision. Q5 uses up to four text lines in a checkbox row without collisions. Q9's compound-subscript tuple occupies a complete final stem line. Q10's long prompt and each two-line option are complete. Q11's frequency expression continues to the next line without losing its value/unit.
observations.mathDisplay: Scientific exponents, Greek and micro-unit glyphs, arrowheads, area powers, calligraphic symbols, vector accents, absolute-value bars, degree marks, DC/AC/rms subscripts, exponential superscript and phasor underlines remain visually recognizable. No raw TeX, formula error color, replacement box or visibly chopped glyph was found.
observations.figure43: The whole Q10 figure is visible: top capacitor strokes, left resistor outline, all C/R/L labels, both right rings, the rightmost voltage-label ending and every bottom coil curve. The label stays within the right gutter and the coil stays above the first checkbox row with white separation.
observations.bottommostContent: Q11 option 4, its circle and micro-unit glyph are fully visible, with bottom white margin. No final row is truncated.

limitations: The actual PNG is 390x6865; the tool presented it at 341x6000. This is not a native-390-pixel font-size or antialiasing assessment, and apparent size must not be compared directly with the unscaled ZH mobile presentation.

The downscale did not prevent stem/option coverage or inspection of the figure's rightmost/bottommost elements. Fine subscript stroke quality and exact minimum-16-pixel compliance cannot be settled from this presentation alone.
No permitted image was reopened to resolve fine-scale details; no additional capture is claimed.
